sections.section: B. New Event Type Discovery (V2 — tighter + long-only)
sections.insight: Tighter parameters reduced noise but didn't create alpha. OI Buildup, Vol Compression, and Failed Breakout patterns are alpha-decayed at 1h scale. Funding extreme mean-reversion is already priced efficiently.

Rank 101+ is too noisy for event-driven alpha. OI Absorption partially works (152 trades, PF=1.25) but 3 trades drive 137% of net profit — not viable without a concentration filter. Deleveraging and RS Shock completely fail.

recommended_registry_update: NONE. No new factors to register. Existing 3 events + rank 20-100 universe confirmed as optimal.
key_insight: The event-driven alpha edge exists ONLY in rank 20-100 (mid-cap by volume). This is the 'sweet spot' — liquid enough for tradability, small enough for structural inefficiencies (forced liquidation, short squeezes). Rank 1-19 is too efficient (regime anchors only). Rank 101+ is too noisy/illiquid. New event types (buildup, compression, breakout, funding) are alpha-decayed at the 1h scale — market makers and HFT firms have already arbitraged these patterns.
research_boundary_confirmed: The pipeline's current scope (3 events, rank 20-100, shadow-only) is the correct and complete configuration. No expansion is warranted based on available data.
